question: Which aircraft's midlife upgrade is a highlight at DRDO’s outdoor display in Aero India 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dornier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dornier aircraft is undergoing a significant midlife upgrade showcased at DRDO’s outdoor display in Aero India 2025.
 
• This upgrade will enhance the operational capabilities of the Dornier, which is widely used by the Indian Armed Forces for surveillance and transport.
 
• The upgrades include advanced avionics, mission systems, and enhanced communication systems to meet modern operational demands.
 
• The Dornier aircraft has been a reliable platform for maritime reconnaissance, training, and light transport missions.
 
• The midlife upgrade will ensure the platform remains effective in the coming decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dornier Aircraft:**

 
 
• A twin-turboprop aircraft manufactured by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) under license from Dornier GmbH.
 
• Primarily used for maritime surveillance, transport, and training by the Indian Navy, Coast Guard, and Air Force.
 
 
 
• **Midlife Upgrade:**
 
 
• Refers to the process of modernizing and upgrading an aircraft’s systems and capabilities to extend its operational life.
 
• Typically includes avionics upgrades, mission-specific equipment, and structural enhancements.
 
 
 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation):**
 
 
• India’s premier defense R&D organization responsible for developing indigenous defense technologies and systems.
 
• Regularly showcases its advancements at Aero India, a premier aerospace exhibition held biennially.
 
 
 
• **Aero India:**
 
 
• A biennial air show and aviation exhibition organized by the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
 
• It serves as a platform for showcasing the latest aerospace technologies and fostering collaborations in the defense sector.
